description: Updates per-company import settings. Pass only the fields you want to change inside 'settings' (e.g. { dateFormat: 'dd/MM/yyyy' }). Fetch current values with get_settings first so you don't clobber unrelated fields. Returns the updated settings.

settings.description: Settings patch. Common fields: dateFormat ('MM/dd/yyyy' | 'dd/MM/yyyy' | 'yyyy-MM-dd'), incrementDocNumber, createMissingProducts, createMissingAccounts, skipDuplicates.

name: update_settings
